# Vendored: evals-skills

Unmodified copies of two skills from [ai-evals-course/evals-skills](https://github.com/ai-evals-course/evals-skills)
(Shreya Shankar and Hamel Husain), licensed under Apache 2.0 (see `LICENSE`). They are kept here because the
paper follows them and the upstream files can change. The commit, each file's git blob hash and SHA-256 are
in `SOURCE.json`; `tests/test_judge.py` fails if a copy is edited.

- `skills/validate-evaluator/SKILL.md`: the judge-validation procedure the study follows.
- `skills/generate-synthetic-data/SKILL.md`: the dimensions-then-text approach used for v3 and v4 tickets.

How the study follows and departs from each step: `paper/method_mapping.md`.
